Yes, that completes editing the way I expect. Saving the draft updated the existing card in place — the new title showed up and the new "Reference" tag appeared alongside the others — and the collection still counted just one bookmark, so it edited what was already there rather than making a new one. Being able to change the title and add a tag like that is exactly the kind of tidying up I want to do.

Editing and tag assignment look good.
